facts.title: Fresh Cranberry Orange Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour
⅓ cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil or melted unsalted butter
¾ cup honey or maple syrup
Zest from 1 medium orange (about 1 teaspoon), preferably organic
1 tablespoon turbinado sugar (also called raw sugar), for sprinkling on top
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
